versions.changelog:
Initial release of the templates skill: read-figma-design

- Adds ability to read context from Figma design URLs in Multica issues without using Figma MCP.
- Automates Figma token handling, REST reads, screenshots, node expansion, style extraction, and artifact writing.
- Provides command-line workflows for reading and validating Figma design context and related artifacts.
- Outlines strict rules for interpreting and citing Figma design data when repairing UI code.
- Includes diagnostics and smoke test commands for setup and troubleshooting.
- Enforces security and usage constraints regarding tokens, artifacts, and commit practices.
